title: Retinal Morpho-functional Evaluation of Patients Affected by Inherited Retinal Dystrophies
official: Retinal Morpho-functional Evaluation of Patients Affected by Inherited Retinal Dystrophies
summary: The present study aims to perform a detailed morpho-anatomical and electro-functional characterization of patients affected by IRD, to investigate on the features of specific retinal layers (outer and inner) and to identify the functional involvement of macular elements located in specific areas. Through a systematic approach to anatomical and functional pattern classifications, this study seeks to refine the phenotypic understanding of IRD and to contribute to a deeper comprehension of its pathophysiological underpinnings, for exploring whether subretinal factors are involving in the etiopathogenesis.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with clinically confirmed inherited retinal dystrophy
* Age between 18 and 90 years
* Male or female patients
* Available recordings of mfERG and mfPhNR, SD-OCT and OCT-A, Visual Acuity (BCVA) and Visual Field (VF)
* Phakic and pseudophakic eyes
* Informed consent freely granted and acquired before data collection

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients underwent cataract surgery 6 months before data acquisition
* Patients with any other ophthalmological diseases affecting cornea, lens, optic nerve and acquired retinal diseases (i.e. central serous chorioretinopathy, retinal vein occlusion, age-related macular degeneration) at the time of data acquisition
* Patients with diabetes and\\or any other systemic condition affecting the macular function and structure
* Patients who underwent to macular laser procedures before data acquisition
* Concomitant treatment with any systemic or ocular drug influencing macular structure and function at the time of data acquisition
